office.title: About the International Office

paragraphs.p1: The university's External Relations Office is a unit that supports the internationalisation of the university and operates under the Regulations of the External Relations Office.
paragraphs.p2: The work of the External Relations Office is carried out by the head of the office and its lead specialist, together with the rector and the university's departments.
paragraphs.p3: The main goal of the office is to address the objectives set out in the university's Strategic Plan: attracting international students and broadening the range of their countries of origin, expanding the university's international cooperation in education and research, and integrating the university into international academic and educational processes, programmes, and more.

office.functionsTitle: The main functions of the university's International Relations are to:

functions.represent: Represent the university in foreign countries
functions.contacts: Establish direct links with relevant educational and scientific institutions and organisations in other countries
functions.training: Cooperate with institutions engaged in specialist training, retraining, and professional development, as well as with research institutions
functions.lecturers: Involve visiting lecturers in the university's teaching and research
functions.foreign: Organise the enrolment of foreign citizens in the university's preparatory and degree programmes, in accordance with the regulations approved by the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Armenia
functions.conferences: Organise national and international conferences and seminars together with the university's research department

paragraphs.p1: SIMU works closely with international partners, delivering professional courses, seminars, and international conferences.
paragraphs.p2: The university's internationalisation and recognition are supported by the participation of its staff and lecturers in conferences, seminars, and events organised by various state and public bodies.
paragraphs.p3: Some of the university's lecturers have taken part in training programmes abroad (Czech Republic, Israel, Germany, USA, Russia, France, and others).
paragraphs.p4: The university also cooperates with the International Academy of Integrative Medicine.

local.p1: The university cooperates with the Armenian Dental Association. Lecturers and students actively take part in all events, seminars, and international conferences organised by the association.
local.p2: All of this helps lecturers and students gain and share international experience and stay well informed.
local.p3: By establishing international relations and signing international and local cooperation agreements, the university seeks to promote the exchange of experience and the internationalisation and improvement of its educational programmes. This strengthens and develops international academic and research links aimed at the international recognition of scientific achievements that support the development of science and education.
